about.title: About G.Jeddah
story: G.Jeddah Aluminum Glass & Wood Interior is a workshop-based fabrication and fitting business serving Islamabad and Rawalpindi. We build and install aluminium windows and doors, glass shopfronts and partitions, shower cabins, wood kitchens and wardrobes, false ceilings and panelling.

The workshop is located on Fateh Jang Rd, E 18 Gulshan e Sehat, Islamabad. All work is made to measure here, then fitted on site by our own team — so the people who build your work are the people who install it.
We are open 24 hours. Whether it is a new shopfront, a kitchen refit, or a repair to an existing unit, start with a call or a message and we will arrange a measure.
mission: Measure accurately, quote clearly, fabricate properly, fit cleanly.
One point of contact across aluminium, glass and wood — so your job does not fall between trades.
Straight answers on what is possible, what it costs, and how long it takes.
